sentences.en: He left his poorly paid job for greener pastures elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 他为了更好的机会离开了那份收入低的工作。

sentences.en: The herds are turned out into the pasture to graze.
sentences.zh: 牧群被放到了草场去吃草。

sentences.en: There are plenty of cows grazing on the mountain pastures.
sentences.zh: 山上的草场上有很多牛在吃草。
